did: Built a game's moment log, every play of a game as the moments it was, and a phone route to read it, so Takes can show the moments with no bite beside them. Drove the engine fixes to main: drives that end at a kickoff or the half, fake field goals, ESPN's team spellings, then big plays for every turnover and special-teams score. Fresh reviews found real bugs each round, mostly in how a reviewed or flagged play was read; those were fixed before merge, and the long tail was filed.

calls.title: The moment log is the whole game, not a list of moments with no bite
options: Serve every play as the moments it was, in the shape just happened already uses
Serve only the moments without a bite
Add the moments to the takes answer
calls.why: One log serves every reading of it, and the phone filters, so the server holds no policy about which moments matter.
calls.undo: Remove the games route and the engine's moment_log.

calls.title: No second play id on the takes answer
options: Have the phone read the play id the answer already carries
calls.why: The id was already there as about.match.play.id; a second name for one fact can drift.
calls.undo: Add playId beside id in the takes answer's play.

calls.title: The moment log ignores the game feed's pause switch
options: Serve the log while the feed is paused
Answer an empty log while paused, as the live socket does
calls.why: The log is the game's record, not a live offer, so a pause only stops it growing.
calls.undo: Read the GameFeed setting in the moment log and answer nothing when it is off.

left: The try's text can still change a scoring play's big-play reading, for example a No-Play flag on a two-point try; the coordinator chose to merge first, and it is server#1103.
Smaller reading gaps in ESPN's wording are filed as server#1099 and #1102, none of them on a recorded game.
